# nexus script

Verbs: get, invoke

## Usage

```
nexus script [flags]
```

## Flags

```
  -h, --help   help for script
```

## Global flags

```
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`nexus script get`](nexus_script_get.md) | List cataloged scripts, or with NAME, get a cataloged script |
| [`nexus script invoke`](nexus_script_invoke.md) | Run a cataloged script |
